name: Mantle of Goodness
body:
School evocation [good]; Level paladin 3

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V

EFFECT

Range self
Area 30-foot-radius centered on you
Duration 1 round/level

You radiate a holy power out to a radius of 30 feet, granting your allies additional power to combat evil. While in the aura’s radius your allies deal 1d6 extra damage on melee or ranged attacks against evil-aligned foes. If the target is undead or an evil outsider, the damage is increased to 1d8.
